scenario_context: Customer disabled auto-renew but was charged. Verify timestamps vs cutoff. If error, refund. Confirm auto-renew OFF now and prevent future charges. Provide timeline.

customer_profile.opening_message: I turned off auto-renew and still got charged today.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent confirms renewal is stopped + explains timestamps + provides refund plan

checkpoints.description: Verify identity and check timestamps (disable vs renewal cutoff)
Explain outcome clearly (refund if eligible / policy if not)
Confirm auto-renew OFF now and prevent future charges
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Reassure them the next charge won’t happen.

checkpoints.description: Provide refund timeline and next update time
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Give a timeline + cadence; don’t be vague.

success_summary: Trust repaired with timestamp verification, prevention of future charges, and refund plan.
